400	Fits.	Combina.
401	In short...	Resumindo...
402	He walked seven days, and didn't eat the whole way.	Andou sete dias e não comeu em todo o caminho.
403	He was hungry. What did he do?	Estava com fome. O que fez?
404	He took clods of earth and put them in his mouth.	Pegou torrões de terra e pôs na boca.
405	He went on foot and reached Jerusalem.	Foi a pé e chegou a Jerusalém.
406	He met Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.	Encontrou Rabã Yochanan ben Zakai.
407	He said to him, "I want to learn Torah."	Disse-lhe: "Quero estudar Torá."
408	He said to him, "Do you know how to read?"	Ele perguntou: "Você sabe ler?"
409	He said, "No."	Respondeu: "Não."
410	"To learn? Do you know anything?"	"Estudar? Sabe alguma coisa?"
411	He knew nothing at all.	Não sabia nada.
412	He said, "Not good. Go to Rabbi Yehoshua."	Disse: "Não está bem. Vá a Rabi Yehoshua."
413	He called Rabbi Yehoshua and said to him, "Take him."	Chamou Rabi Yehoshua e disse: "Leve-o."
414	Rabbi Yehoshua took him.	Rabi Yehoshua o levou.
415	Now, Rabbi Yehoshua didn't prepare dinner for him, and he was hungry.	Rabi Yehoshua não lhe preparou o jantar, e ele estava com fome.
416	So he kept quiet and didn't speak.	Então ficou calado, não falou.
417	The next morning he came to Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai and spoke with him,	Na manhã seguinte foi a Rabã Yochanan ben Zakai e falou com ele,
418	and he saw a bad smell coming out of his mouth.	e ele sentiu um mau cheiro saindo da sua boca.
419	He said to him, "Did you eat?"	Perguntou-lhe: "Você comeu?"
420	He said, "No."	Respondeu: "Não."
421	He called Rabbi Yehoshua: "Why didn't you feed him?"	Chamou Rabi Yehoshua: "Por que não lhe deu de comer?"
422	He said, "You brought him to me, I thought he ate at your place."	Disse: "O senhor o trouxe a mim, pensei que ele tinha comido com o senhor."
423	He said to him, "I sent him to you so that you would feed	Disse-lhe: "Eu o enviei ao senhor para que o alimentasse."
424	him."	…
425	Between the two of them, the poor man was lost.	Entre os dois, o coitado quase se perdeu.
426	Fine. He said to him, "May it be His will that just as a bad smell came out of your mouth,	Bem. Disse-lhe: "Que seja a vontade de HaShem que, assim como saiu mau cheiro da sua boca,
427	so too your fragrance will spread through Torah."	assim o seu aroma se espalhe pela Torá."
428	He began to learn Torah and became like an ever-strengthening spring,	Começou a estudar Torá e tornou-se como uma fonte que se fortalece,
429	through that same Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.	por meio do mesmo Rabã Yochanan ben Zakai.
430	Well, a year went by, two years. His father says, "Where	Bem, passou-se um ano, dois anos. O pai dele diz: "Onde	
431	is Eliezer?	está Eliezer?
432	Where is Eliezer?	Onde está Eliezer?
433	Maybe he went off to eat carob, who knows what he's doing."	Talvez tenha ido comer alfarroba, quem sabe o que faz."
434	He said, "I'm going up to Jerusalem to disinherit him from all the property."	Disse: "Vou subir a Jerusalém para deserdá-lo de todos os bens."
435	He makes a will: all the brothers will receive, he will receive nothing.	Faz um testamento: todos os irmãos receberão, ele não receberá nada.
436	So he took his sons with him and went to Jerusalem.	Então levou os filhos consigo e foi a Jerusalém.
437	He went up to Jerusalem; Rabbi Eliezer's friends saw him and said	Subiu a Jerusalém; os colegas de Rabi Eliezer o viram e disseram
438	to Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, "His father has come."	a Rabã Yochanan ben Zakai: "O pai dele chegou."
439	He said, "Yes, that's right."	Disse: "Sim, é verdade."
